title: ssh-trust document (stdin of ship-ctl ssh-trust, version 1)
description: What FleetLedger, as the fleet's SSH certificate authority, installs on a Ship: its host certificate, the CA keys whose user certificates the agent user accepts, and the revocation list. Every field is optional; a field that is present replaces what the Ship has. Public material only: never a private key. See contracts/ship-ctl.md.

host_certificate.description: One OpenSSH host certificate line for the Ship's own ed25519 host key. The Ship refuses it unless it is a host certificate, certifies exactly /etc/ssh/ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub, lists the Ship's name among its principals, and has not expired.

user_ca_keys.description: Public keys of the user CAs whose certificates may log in as agent (more than one during a CA rotation). An empty list turns certificate logins off.

revoked_keys.description: An OpenSSH key revocation list (KRL, from ssh-keygen -k), base64. Keys and certificates in it are refused for every user.
